summary: Candidate is a distinct safety rule for ProcessPoolExecutor initializer exception handling at the session/initialization stage. It does not semantically overlap with existing skills (which cover Virtual WAN routing) or peer candidates (which address ThreadPoolExecutor deadlock prevention, BrokenProcessPool recovery, and BrokenThreadPool handling). While peer candidate 41105c9d addresses BrokenProcessPool recovery post-failure, this candidate enforces proactive exception propagation during initializer execution—a complementary but distinct capability at an earlier stage (initialization vs. execution). The candidate has clear support evidence and no conflicts.
